office_does: The county auditor runs elections and voter registration, vehicle and vessel licensing and document recording, and keeps the county's payroll, accounts and financial reports.
race_blurb: Two-term Auditor Sandy Perkins is retiring and endorses Democrat Jeremy Harrison-Smith, the governor's regional representative. Former Mount Vernon councilmember Mark Hulst runs as an independent and is recommended by the county Republican Party, which he once chaired. Harrison-Smith led the primary 54% to 46%. The two gave the same answers on voter fraud, the 2020 election and mail voting, so the race mostly turns on partisanship and experience.

candidates.summary: Governor's Northwest Washington representative and former nonprofit director, running as a Democrat and first-time candidate who pitches 'a new generation of leadership.'
highlights: Pledges to protect vote-by-mail and work with state partners on election security [S1]
Wants expanded language access, bilingual staff and a joint auditor-assessor-treasurer front desk [S1][S5]
Proposes exploring live-streamed ballot processing to build trust [S3]
Endorsed by Auditor Sandy Perkins and the Skagit County Democrats [S1][S6]

experience.basis: Pitches 'a new generation of leadership' and new ideas as a first-time candidate, while drawing on state-government ties and the outgoing auditor's endorsement.

candidates.summary: Former 12-year Mount Vernon city councilmember and business owner running as an independent on management experience and nonpartisan administration.
highlights: Chaired the Mount Vernon City Council's finance and public safety committees, 2012-2023 [S1][S5]
Says the office should be run 'without unnecessary rhetoric or partisanship' and in full compliance with state law [S1][S2]
Proposes regular audits of vehicle-licensing sub-agencies and a property-title fraud alert service [S5]
Former Skagit County Republican Party chair; the party now recommends him [S5][S6]

experience.basis: Runs as 'The Experienced Choice' on 12 years of city council and business management, but has not worked in an auditor's office.
